findings.title: Make study change what a character can do
findings.source_observation: Active study produces research and a small arcana effect; scroll holdings modify research rate and capacity, while lore modifies capacity and arcana.
findings.interpretation: Read a short field manual, practice its method, and use it in one native gathering task. Keep reading progress separate from trained skill and equipped means.
findings.smallest_slice: A native book plus one useful gathering technique; Literacy still earns XP and the old book rewards remain intact.
findings.acceptance_gate: Book reading reaches completion; technique is learned but cannot execute without its declared tool; gather with tool and see the practical outcome.
findings.priority_reason: Highest: connects existing books, ordinary skills and work without selecting a new magic world.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Let the Shack become a working home
findings.source_observation: Furniture modifies concrete task costs/rates/caps and occupies space; homes provide different capacity and running costs.
findings.interpretation: Craft a reading stand or workbench for the Shack; choose a practical benefit that applies only while using that place. Start with one furnishing, not a universal room-slot system.
findings.smallest_slice: One crafted study stand changes one book task at the Shack and records that the player furnished their home.
findings.acceptance_gate: Enter Shack, compare reading rate before/after installation, leave and verify location-specific benefit ends; reload/import preserves one installation.
findings.priority_reason: High: a lived place develops through work; audit existing Proto23 and home-workshop owners before duplicating them.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Show why a routine stopped
findings.source_observation: Runner separates active/waiting/goals/hobbies; retries eligible work, rests, and blocks work for caps, full resources or unaffordable running costs.
findings.interpretation: Give native activity/read/craft rows a clear blocked reason and optional stop-at-goal. Propose a repeat/rest/resume cycle only after its native host is checked.
findings.yair_mapping: src/activities.js:16-79; src/main.js:2248-2301; src/display.js:4457; src/simulation.js:311-329 (existing counted programs)
findings.smallest_slice: One task stops at its resource or target limit, says why, and needs no hidden click loop.
findings.acceptance_gate: Run to target, exhaust the declared resource, stop manually, change location and verify no old task resumes by accident.
findings.priority_reason: High: visible agency and predictable idling; Theory runner is evidence, not a YAIR API.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Make an apprenticeship a chapter in a life
findings.source_observation: Jobs alter learning ceilings and passive earnings; apprenticeship graduation has distinct priced and dark alternatives.
findings.interpretation: Offer an optional village craft apprenticeship: ordinary job work trains the trade, mentor tasks unlock a practical method, and graduation adds a recorded title. Existing fieldwork remains available.
findings.smallest_slice: One mentor and one commission with an explicit completion consequence.
findings.acceptance_gate: Accept, defer, earn reward exactly once, and verify native quest/job access remains; inspect reload/import for title and commission.
findings.priority_reason: Medium-high: careers connect people, work and lasting biography; no forced master murder or replacement opening.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Keep basic learning useful beyond its first unlock
findings.source_observation: Language and history study cross-modify other rates/caps; an education module adds further learning upgrades.
findings.interpretation: Use a specific Literacy or Meditation milestone to improve one later task, with a visible causal explanation. Avoid a compulsory generic research bar across worlds.
findings.smallest_slice: One learned practice changes a later recipe or reading task through an existing skill check.
findings.acceptance_gate: Compare below/above threshold and show the exact changed cost or result; verify bonus applied once and persists.
findings.priority_reason: Medium: ordinary skills remain relevant; numerical balance is an original proposal.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Turn expendable notes into lasting understanding
findings.source_observation: Scribing consumes research/mana, binding consumes scrolls/research/mana; sublimation trades tangible lore goods for capacity modifiers.
findings.interpretation: Bind gathered notes into a manual, then optionally consume a copy to learn a permanent local method. Keep the source book and understood method distinct; do not assume knowledge guarantees execution.
findings.smallest_slice: One note-to-book recipe and one optional learned technique, using native item transactions.
findings.acceptance_gate: Insufficient notes spends nothing; valid craft debits exactly once; study preserves native book semantics; reload/import does not duplicate method.
findings.priority_reason: Medium: one material chain creates tangible research; Theory sublimation is not proof of cross-life persistence.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Put progress explanations in the existing center menu
findings.source_observation: Skill UI shows owned/unowned, level/cap, train/stop, experience progress; resource groups retain hide settings; filter box searches names.
findings.interpretation: Show current progress, goal, known prerequisite and practical reward on one task row; add a filter only when the list is large. No Theory layout transplant.
findings.yair_mapping: src/display.js:103-108; src/main.js:2248-2301; src/items.js:1138-1152; src/display.js:4457-4471 (existing progress and remaining time)
findings.smallest_slice: A reading row states time remaining and what completion will allow, respecting undiscovered information.
findings.acceptance_gate: Fresh browser verifies narrow/normal width, keyboard operation, disabled reason and no hidden-world spoiler; screenshot the exact changed row.
findings.priority_reason: Medium: clear choices help dense systems feel manageable.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

findings.title: Explore prestige that preserves a lived character
findings.source_observation: Hall glossary explicitly describes preserved progress, switchable new characters and separately saved prestige; hall controller has slots and dismissal.
findings.interpretation: Consider a later mentor hall or legacy archive where accomplishments aid a new character without erasing the existing one. Keep travel, learning, death and prestige separate.
findings.smallest_slice: Design-only retention matrix for one prestige layer; no reset code or extra-character implementation authorized.
findings.acceptance_gate: Before implementation select ownership, retained goods/knowledge/relationships, import semantics and one exploit test; then fresh-origin save/reload/import.
findings.priority_reason: Later: strong conceptual alternative, but largest persistence scope and not the next content wave.
findings.verification: static-source-inspected; execution-unrun; exact user build unknown

src/npc_lives.js:5-39 already represents bounded predetermined household history; this audit proposes no general new NPC scheduler.
src/display.js:4457-4471 already shows reading time remaining and a progress bar; P7 extends causal explanation, T01 is optional wording rather than new remaining-time support.
